svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Elevation of a colonnade: seven evenly spaced columns on a stone base carrying one continuous straight beam, frieze and cornice, with a round close-up of one column head and the beam above it. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
svg.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
